material_results: AgentA currently enforces sample/code secrecy for holdout/ but exposes exact numeric holdout feedback through repository-visible rejection/archive/commit surfaces under the installer ACL model; scaffold-edit explicitly skips benchmark and sealed-holdout tiers, so the stronger self-modifying + hidden behavioral gate + bounded feedback conjunction is not supported by the pinned public implementation.

Adaptive fresh-confirmation alpha spending is valid under the explicit contract that candidate/null identity and alpha_j are fixed before current fresh outcomes, conditional null rejection is <= alpha_j, and lifetime pathwise spend is <= alpha_global. Tian-Ramdas Online Fallback provides arbitrary-dependence recycling; applying it to adaptively created candidates requires that same conditional-predictable interface. Hartog-Lei e-Fallback is fixed-family and does not directly prove an unbounded adaptive candidate-identity stream.

CLDD final public code uses ten training/error streams, a separate ten-seed evaluation set, and 30-trial Optuna maximization of mean my_f1. Older public source used five training streams. Exact winning detector HP artifacts are written under ignored logs and omitted from the parquet schema, so exact released-dataset HP provenance remains unbound without an external artifact or rerun.

FirstResearch code really implements a certificate with falsifier/minimal decisive test/failure-update fields, a deterministic gate, LLM repair before experiment design, and blocks experiment-plan generation on failed gate. The one-repeat DeepSeek and partial second Gemini score artifacts support certificate/gate-repair package quality, but CertificateOnly is slightly above Full; generic reviewer/meta layers and executed-science quality are not established.

ABS primary results verify stronger attackers than Self-RedTeam against the same base defender at 3B/7B and a catastrophic 7B rank-32 step50->step100 collapse trajectory. The attacker gap is a multi-axis system comparison rather than a single-factor parameter-sharing causal estimate; the collapse is one reported unstable configuration, not a frequency estimate.
